preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and n % 2 == 0 and 2 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines), n+1)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an even integer between 2 and 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for n, dominoes in zip([int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines), n+1)], [[(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in [line.split() for line in lines[i+1:i+1+n]]] for i in range(1, len(lines), n+1)]) for a, b in dominoes)
preconditions.description: Each domino contains two integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: sum([int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines), n+1)]) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'Yes', 'yes', 'yEs', 'YeS', 'YES', 'No', 'no', 'nO', 'NO'] for i in range(len(output_lines)))
postconditions.description: Each line of output is a case-insensitive YES or NO.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] in ['YES', 'Yes', 'yes', 'yEs', 'YeS', 'YES']) == (exists_valid_partition(n, dominoes)) for i, (n, dominoes) in enumerate(zip([int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines), n+1)], [[(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in [line.split() for line in lines[i+1:i+1+n]]] for i in range(1, len(lines), n+1)])))
postconditions.description: Output YES if and only if there exists a partition of the dominoes into two sets such that within each set, all numbers on the dominoes are distinct; otherwise output NO.
